Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for NIT Kurukshetra Training & Placement Officer Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the post name for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is for the post of Training & Placement Officer at NIT Kurukshetra.

faq.question: Q2. What is the total number of vacancies?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy for the Training & Placement Officer post.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode is Walk-in. Candidates need to attend the interview directly.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The last date for the walk-in interview is 27 August 2026.

faq.question: Q5. What is the educational qualification required?
faq.answer: A B.E./B.Tech degree or MBA Degree in a relevant field with first class or equivalent grade is required. Desirable experience is also mentioned.

faq.question: Q6. What is the age limit for the candidate?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the candidate is 60 years.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary offered for this post?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a salary of Rs. 89,760/- per month.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee?
faq.answer: No application fee is mentioned for any category.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process?
faq.answer: The selection process includes Document Verification and a Walk-in Interview.

faq.question: Q10. Where is the walk-in interview scheduled to be held?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is scheduled to be held at National Institute of Technology Kurukshetra, Haryana, Pin Code: 136119.
